name: Chadodoro WebMCP
description: Browser-native Model Context Protocol tools for Chadodoro Pomodoro and Touch Grass app

tools.name: getTimerState
tools.description: Returns the current status of Chadodoro: mode, remaining seconds, running state, and grass counter

tools.name: startTimer
tools.description: Starts or resumes the Pomodoro countdown timer

tools.name: pauseTimer
tools.description: Pauses the currently running countdown timer

tools.name: resetTimer
tools.description: Resets the countdown timer to the initial duration of the current phase

tools.name: skipPhase
tools.description: Skips immediately to the next timer phase

tools.name: setMode
tools.description: Switches the active timer phase mode

mode.description: The target phase to switch to

tools.name: touchGrass
tools.description: Logs that the user stepped outside and touched physical grass, incrementing the counter and triggering celebratory effects

tools.name: playMotivation
tools.description: Plays an instant stoic GigaChad motivational one-liner from the voice vault

tools.name: toggleVoice
tools.description: Toggles the GigaChad spoken voice coach on or off

tools.name: toggleBgm
tools.description: Toggles background anthem music on or off
